name: ultracode
description: Ultracode for GLM: a budget-aware orchestration layer — a router skill, commands and role agents for six workflow patterns (research, implement, audit, decide, converge, sweep; the saved workflows themselves install via scripts/install.sh or ship in the repo's .zcode/workflows/), and a destructive-command guard hook.

description_i18n.en: Ultracode for GLM: a budget-aware orchestration layer — a router skill, commands and role agents for six workflow patterns (research, implement, audit, decide, converge, sweep; the saved workflows themselves install via scripts/install.sh or ship in the repo's .zcode/workflows/), and a destructive-command guard hook.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 GLM 的 Ultracode：预算感知的编排层 —— 路由 Skill、六个工作流模式（research、implement、audit、decide、converge、sweep，saved workflows 本体经由 scripts/install.sh 安装或随仓库 .zcode/workflows/ 提供）的命令与角色 Agent，以及危险命令拦截 Hook。
